title: Preserve explicit operations on foreign-branch tasks
description: Verify and, where necessary, adjust explicit task operations so foreign scoped tasks remain visible in list/show/graph and can be updated, commented, paused, completed, or started by exact UUID/short ID. An eligible foreign todo/paused task shown from another branch must report readiness.claimable=false and never appear in ready/next, but task start must still succeed after normal assignee/dependency checks. Add focused provider/CLI tests for foreign short-ID resolution, explicit start, status movement, comments, updates, and ambiguous/unknown identifiers. Do not add a force or steal flag.
